newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki stocks correct down, end near day-lows.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki stocks correct down, end near day-lows.

text.p: Shares fell in line with a broad international correction on fairly solid profit-taking as a sudden end to the interim reporting season opened a news vaccuum with scant domestic impulses, brokers said.
Kemira, trading actively after details of its share issue and the state's sale of stock were released on Tuesday, held above its 49.50 markka issue price to end at 50.30, down 1.20.
The state said after the close the issue had been successful and it would exercise an option to sell two million more shares.
"We could probably see another correction lower tomorrow, but not as much as today," said one broker, looking at charts.
But as ever he added the U.S. market will set the tone.
Nokia was marked quite sharply down as tech stocks turned bearish in New York overnight, and profit-takers sliced over two percent off Huhtamaki in relatively active dealings.
Merita's rally was again stalled by the overall tone, but the recently firm banking group fell less hard than some of its fellows, and in thinner volume than of late.

Neste racked up sharp gains against the trend, adding four markka to park its closing price back above 100 at 101.00, but volume was very light. Brokers noted the stock can be volatile with few shares in issue. -- Helsinki newsroom +35 89 6805 0247
